newsitem.title: USA: Tandycrafts adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Tandycrafts adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Tandycrafts Inc on Monday said its board had adopted a shareholders' rights plan that would be exercisable if a party acquired or sought to acquire more than 15 percent of the company's common stock.

Each right allows shareholders to buy one common share for $30 but are not initially exercisable. If someone tries to buy 15 percent of the company's shares, the rights become exercisable and allow their holders to buy $30 worth of Tandycrafts' common stock at one half of the then-market price, the company said.
The company said the action was being taken to enhance shareholder value and is intended to force potential acquirers to treat all Tandycrafts shareholders fairly and equally.
The company said its board had been considering adopting a plan for several weeks.
"We believe that the current market price of Tandycrafts' common stock and the positive prospects for the company make the adoption of the plan prudent at this time," the company said in a statement.
The company did not immediately return a call seeking further comment.
Tandycrafts shares closed Monday unchanged at 4-3/4.
